_what_this_is: Ionic Wealth's own credentials, as they appear at the front of a client deck: the group's scale, who the co-founders are, what the firm claims as its edge, and the desk's current asset-class view. Published centrally with the calls and the house view, for exactly the same reason: an advisor cannot edit the firm's AUM or a co-founder's record to suit a meeting, and two advisors cannot send two different versions of it in the same week. Transcribed from the deck the desk already uses; every figure here is the firm's own.

asset_class_view_sub: Key signals across major asset classes shaping our portfolio positioning

asset_class_view.read: Improving macros, earnings revival, palatable valuations (Nifty 1Y forward PE ~18x). Geo-political headwinds warrant staggered deployment.
rows: Two-part stagger: 50% in 0 to 15 days, 50% in 15 to 30 days
50% value, 25% low vol, 25% momentum, overweight value

asset_class_view.read: Strong AI-driven tech earnings; valuations below end-2025. US earnings outstanding, with selective emerging-market exposure.
rows: 60% developed markets including the US, 40% emerging ex-India
Global at 30% of the equity book via lumpsum; the opportunity set is attractive now
South Korea most attractive: cheap valuations with high EPS growth

asset_class_view.read: Short-term volatility from global factors. Fiscal and balance-of-payments risks keep the rate trajectory uncertain.
rows: 85% in 3 to 5 year papers, 15% in 30 year and longer bonds
Selective participation amid an uncertain rate trajectory
30 year and longer now 15%, down from 25%; locks in yields, held as accrual

asset_class_view.read: The rupee is volatile in a 90 to 96 range. Dollar strength, FPI outflows and elevated oil all weigh on it.
rows: Band of 90 to 96; RBI and central-bank capital measures should curb rupee weakness
A reserves drawdown of about USD 47 billion since the February peak limits the defence of the rupee

asset_class_view.read: Gold favoured over silver as a geo-political hedge. Persistent central-bank buying and a supply squeeze support gold.
rows: Staggered accumulation: gold around USD 4,200, silver at USD 65 or below

asset_class_view.read: Q1 2026 private-equity deployment was about USD 9.2 billion, with IT and ITES leading at USD 5.1 billion. Private equity is entering a disciplined, quality-driven phase.
rows: Commercial real estate on a steady growth path, led by Bengaluru and Delhi NCR
Late-stage and buyout focus over early-stage venture at this point in the cycle
